install_order: ha-v1.0.0rc6 (HACS, then a Home Assistant restart)
v1.0.0-e32v2-rc.5 (Home Assistant Firmware update entity, one Install press), attended, with the owner at home, with pre- and post-install capture as the acceptance receipt (tools/acceptance)
confirm the takeover again right after the update (Repairs, or Rooms on the E32); until then the E32 keeps only frost protection
publication_condition: the owner's explicit go with the one-time exception over the unaccepted rc.4 (recorded) and green exact-tag CI
changes: The E32 listens to the boiler: held targets, the boiler's own rest rhythm and the heat the house takes from the flow and return temperatures give a learned ceiling on the water temperature per outdoor band and a floor under the burner rest; a room a degree or more short still gets the full water temperature.

A house model: the heat loss per degree outside and the emitter output per degree of water temperature, and from them an earlier weather-compensation line until the curve is learned from steady periods.
One knowledge figure with what the E32 still has to learn, in plain words, on the E32 pages and in Home Assistant.
Insights: yesterday judged against the house's own baselines (gas per degree-day, burner starts per heating hour, heating hours per degree-day, warm-up time per room), as information only.
Free heat: sun, cooking and people that warm a room without the boiler are learned per room and daypart, and shorten Smart warm-up starts once seen five times.
A heating-curve chart (water temperature by outdoor temperature: standard, learned, now on the line) on the E32 Home page and the Home Assistant Learning view.

The Home Assistant dashboard redesigned after the owner's sketches: a house card with a coloured status band, figures and the day strip on the Overview, room cards with chips, Today and House cards, a Boiler "Now" card with the four figures and the burner gauge, the Boiler view in order of need with one gas-per-day chart, the Learning view in seven sections with Yesterday once, tabs with their names.

Home Assistant stopped sending room values to the E32 about four hours after every start (1.0.0rc5): a five-minute refresh ran on the wrong thread and used up the send queue; fixed, with a watch on both sides (a repair with advice after 15 minutes, the E32 says why it refused an input and re-subscribes after silence).
Boiler settings the boiler reports only when asked stay visible on the E32 pages and in Home Assistant with the time of the last reading, instead of going unknown after ten minutes.
A new installation no longer reports a restored room group or duplicate entity IDs; codes and counts show as whole numbers; the holiday line no longer leaves an empty card.
The per-room learned telemetry budget is 1100 B, the house model's slope is bounded to 1.5 times the design slope, and the telemetry summary split cannot leak under low memory.
The release publication waits for GitHub's lagging release list after creating, uploading and publishing, and logs every step, so the first attempt succeeds.

A test-evening script for the attended switch-over tests T1-T12, a package for the installation tester, and a demo Home Assistant that renders the whole dashboard for screenshots; a house without radiator valves passes the valve criterion as not applicable.
not_included: the weather forecast as an input to the warm-up start and the water temperature
separate pause delays for door and window contacts
reading every boiler setting on the E32's own request every six hours (only the heating temperature is read; the rest arrives when another device asks)
